source.title: Human brain organoids record the passage of time over multiple years

source_supported_observations: human cortical organoids were cultured for over five years
transcriptional and methylation age tracked time in vitro
old progenitors retained developmental-age information after reaggregation
in heterochronic cultures old progenitors responded to young signals but produced later fates rapidly
not_source_supported: a specific molecular storage mechanism for temporal memory
